messages.subject: Nvim-R 0.9.18 (broken on Windows) released
messages.body_plain:
A new version of Nvim-R is released. The TCP connection with R is broken on Windows, which means that the plugin does not work there.
The changes in the new version are:
TCP communication on Windows is broken.
Integration with cmp-nvim-r, a source for nvim-cmp.
Delete options R_auto_omni and R_hi_fun_globenv.
New options: R_filetypes, R_fun_data_1 and R_fun_data_2, R_quarto_intel, R_bib_compl, R_enable_comment.
Require either Neovim 0.6.0 or Vim 8.2.84.
Note: only today did I see that some people had their request to participate in this group pending approval. I'm sorry for that.

Best regards,

Jakson Aquino

messages.subject: Nvim-R working on Windows again
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I fixed the TCP connection bug, and the default "master" branch of Nvim-R on github is working on Windows again. I will release a new version in a couple of days, and it would  be great if those using Windows could try the github version of Nvim-R to report any bug that eventually remains.

Thank you!

Jakson Aquino

messages.subject: Nvim-R 0.9.19 released
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I released a new version of Nvim-R. I couldn't upload it to vim.org <http://vim.org> because it seems to exceed the new size limit for uploads. You can download it from https://github.com/jalvesaq/Nvim-R/releases although I suggest the use of a plugin manager and then, you can choose the branch that best fits your needs:
https://github.com/jalvesaq/Nvim-R/branches

Best regards,

Jakson Aquino

messages.subject: Re: Nvim-R 0.9.19 released
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

That's because I don't know git commands very well. Instead of
"upgrading" the stable branch, I deleted it and created it again. So,
the branch histories are unrelated. I'm sorry for that. There is a
simple workaround: completely uninstall the plugin or delete the
directory and install or clone it again.

I hope this helps...

Best,

Jakson
